events.title: RB-47 radar/visual UFO encounters over Mississippi to Texas, 17 Jul 1957
events.source: FBI Case File 255 — UFOs and Defense, What Should We Prepare For, p.0018
events.report_summary:
**Document:** This page is a narrative account of the well-known RB-47 incident, not a stand-alone signed incident report. The scan has no visible FBI header, file number, classification stamp, or signature block on the page itself; instead it summarizes testimony later discussed by MacDonald in 1969 and compares it with Klass’s analysis.

**Witness:** The main witness named in the text is Commander Chase, the aircraft commander/pilot, with corroborating observations from Captain MacCoyd (copilot), Captain Provenzano, and electronic/radar observer MacClure. The page says six officers were interviewed and that three additional officers in the cockpit could also see outside the aircraft, strengthening the credibility of the account.

**Sighting:** The encounter unfolded during the RB-47’s northbound return from the Gulf of Mexico toward the Mississippi coast and then across Louisiana and Texas. Around 0930Z over Mississippi, MacClure saw a radar blip behind and to the right of the aircraft that passed it, arced around, and reappeared on the left; the pulse characteristics matched ground radar except for shorter 2-microsecond pulses. Around 1010Z in Louisiana, Chase and MacCoyd saw an intense bluish-white light that moved from left to right and vanished. At 1030Z a similar signal reappeared from about 2 o’clock and was confirmed by another detector. Near Dallas, Utah radar tracked both the aircraft and an object holding a constant 18 km separation. At 1039Z Chase saw a large red light apparently below the aircraft, and at 1042Z the object turned toward Dallas; by about 1050Z west of Dallas it stopped and disappeared from both radar and visual contact.

**Object:** The object was reported as airborne, fast-moving, and apparently responsive to the aircraft, with radar returns suggesting a microwave source and visual appearances ranging from bluish-white to red. The author notes that some sightings could have involved meteors or optical effects, but the radar/visual correlation and persistent tracking made a simple explanation difficult.

**Investigation:** The page emphasizes that the crew initially suspected an electronics malfunction, then later reported the contacts to Utah radar. The narrative concludes that, while some details remain debatable, the episode presented multiple independent radar and visual observations over a long flight path, and it remains one of the stronger historical military UFO cases.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document:** 本页是一段关于著名 RB-47 事件的叙述性说明，而不是一份独立签署的事件报告。该扫描页本身没有可见的 FBI 页眉、档案编号、机密印章或签名栏；相反，它概述了后来 MacDonald 在 1969 年讨论过的证词，并将其与 Klass 的分析进行比较。

**Witness:** 文中提到的主要证人是 Chase 指挥官，亦即飞机指挥官/飞行员，另有 McCoyd 舰长（副驾驶）、Provenzano 舰长以及电子/雷达观察员 MacClure 的佐证。该页称共有六名军官接受了采访，并且驾驶舱内另外三名军官也能看到机外情况，这进一步增强了该叙述的可信度。

**Sighting:** 这次遭遇发生在 RB-47 从墨西哥湾向北返回、飞越 Mississippi 海岸，随后经过 Louisiana 和 Texas 的途中。约在 0930Z，位于 Mississippi 上空时，MacClure 看到飞机后方右侧有一个雷达回波点，随后该目标超越飞机，绕弧形机动后又出现在左侧；其脉冲特征与地面雷达相符，但脉冲宽度较短，为 2 微秒。约在 1010Z、位于 Louisiana 上空时，Chase 和 McCoyd 看见一道强烈的蓝白色光点从左向右移动并消失。到 1030Z 时，同样的信号又从大约 2 点钟方向出现，并被另一台探测器证实。在接近 Dallas 时，Utah 雷达同时跟踪到了飞机和一个始终保持 18 km 间距的目标。1039Z，Chase 看到一团巨大的红色光点，似乎位于飞机下方；1042Z 时，该目标转向 Dallas；到大约 1050Z，在 Dallas 西侧，它停止并从雷达与目视中同时消失。

**Object:** 该目标被描述为空中飞行、速度很快，并且似乎会对飞机作出反应；雷达回波提示其可能是微波源，而目视外观则从蓝白色到红色不等。作者指出，部分目击也可能与流星或光学效应有关，但雷达与目视的对应关系以及持续跟踪使得简单解释变得困难。

**Investigation:** 本页强调，机组人员起初怀疑是电子设备故障，之后才将这些接触报告给 Utah 雷达。叙述最后指出，尽管某些细节仍有争议，但这一事件在漫长的飞行航线上呈现了多重独立的雷达与目视观察结果，至今仍是历史上较为有力的军事 UFO 案例之一。

events.date_raw: Night of August 13-14, 1956, at 2255 hours; page section headed "2.1 Lakenheath (United Kingdom) (August 13-14, 1956)"
events.title: Lakenheath/Bentwaters radar and light sightings, 13-14 Aug 1956
events.source: FBI Case File 255 — UFOs and Defense, What Should We Prepare For, p.0016
events.report_summary:
**Document:** This page is a secondary-source case writeup, section 2.1, titled "Lakenheath (United Kingdom) (August 13-14, 1956)." It is not an original FBI memo on the page shown; instead it summarizes a military UFO case and cites later analyses, including the 1969 Condon Commission report, a 1971 study by Thayer in *Astronautics and Aeronautics*, and a 1976 critique by Philippe Klass. No FBI file number, classification marking, signer, or originating office is visible on this page.

**Witness:** The incident was reported by multiple independent observers: Bentwaters base radar/control personnel, a Bentwaters control-tower observer, a military transport pilot flying over Bentwaters, and later Lakenheath radar operators and the shift supervisor. The narrative emphasizes concurrence between radar and visual observations, which is presented as strengthening credibility.

**Sighting:** On the night of 13-14 August 1956, around 2255 hours, radar at Bentwaters detected an unidentified object moving east to west over the base at an estimated 2,000-4,000 mph (3,200-6,400 km/h), with no sonic boom reported. At the same time, control-tower personnel saw a bright light traveling east to west at "an incredible speed" at roughly 1,200 m altitude, and a military transport pilot said a bright light passed beneath his aircraft in the same direction and at similar speed.

**Object:** The page also describes a second radar contact near Lakenheath: a stationary object about 40 km southwest of the base, on the projected track of the earlier object, which later accelerated from apparent immobility to 600-950 km/h. The object is described only as an unidentified aerial object/bright light; no shape, size, color detail, or sound signature beyond the absence of a sonic boom is given.

**Investigation:** Bentwaters radar personnel reported the sightings to Lakenheath air traffic control, which confirmed a related radar target and alerted the base commander. The text states that the Condon Commission later judged the case "unidentified," while subsequent authors disputed or tried to conventionalize parts of the event. On this page alone, the case remains unresolved and is treated as a significant concurrent radar/visual UFO incident over eastern England.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document:** 本页是一份二手来源的案例综述，属于第 2.1 节，标题为“Lakenheath (United Kingdom) (August 13-14, 1956)”。页面所示内容并非原始 FBI 备忘录；相反，它总结了一个军事 UFO 案件，并引用了后来的分析，包括 1969 年的 Condon Commission 报告、Thayer 于 *Astronautics and Aeronautics* 上发表的 1971 年研究，以及 Philippe Klass 于 1976 年的批评。此页上未显示 FBI 档案编号、机密等级标记、签署人或出处办公室。

**Witness:** 该事件由多名彼此独立的目击者报告：Bentwaters 基地雷达/管制人员、Bentwaters 塔台观察员、一名飞越 Bentwaters 的军用运输机飞行员，以及后来 Lakenheath 的雷达操作员和当班主管。叙述强调雷达与目视观测之间的一致性，并将其作为增强可信度的依据。

**Sighting:** 1956 年 8 月 13 日至 14 日夜间，约 2255 hours，Bentwaters 的雷达探测到一个不明物体以估计 2,000-4,000 mph (3,200-6,400 km/h) 的速度自东向西掠过基地，且未报告音爆。与此同时，塔台人员看到一束明亮的光以“惊人的速度”自东向西飞行，约在 1,200 m 高度；一名军用运输机飞行员则称，一束明亮的光以相同方向、相近速度从其飞机下方掠过。

**Object:** 页面还描述了 Lakenheath 附近的第二个雷达接触目标：一个位于基地西南约 40 km 的静止目标，处于先前物体的推定航迹上，随后又从看似静止突然加速至 600-950 km/h。该物体仅被描述为一个不明空中物体/明亮光点；除未出现音爆这一点外，没有提供形状、尺寸、颜色或声音特征方面的细节。

**Investigation:** Bentwaters 的雷达人员将目击情况报告给 Lakenheath 空中交通管制部门，后者确认了一个相关雷达目标，并通知了基地指挥官。文中指出，Condon Commission 随后将此案判定为“unidentified”，而后来的作者则对事件的部分内容提出质疑，或试图将其常规化。仅就本页而言，该案仍未得到解决，并被视为英国东部一起具有重要意义的雷达/目视同步 UFO 事件。

events.location: Near Tours, Indre-et-Loire, France (in flight over the Rennes–Nantes–Poitiers route)

events.title: Tours, France: green sphere on collision course with T-33, 3 Mar 1976
events.source: FBI Case File 255 — UFOs and Defense, What Should We Prepare For, p.0014
events.report_summary:
**Document:** Page p.0014 from FBI case file 255 is a French-language UFO report excerpt. It ends a separate Mirage IV/A1-A2 incident and then begins a new section titled “1.2 Testimony of a Fighter Pilot (March 3, 1976).” The witness initially requested anonymity in the written deposition later attributed to Claude Bosc. No file number, signer, or classification marking is visible on this page.

**Witness:** P was a student pilot at the Combat Flight School at Tours at the time of the sighting. He was flying solo in a T-33 training aircraft on a night navigation mission at 6,000 m altitude and about 460 km/h, following the Rennes–Nantes–Poitiers itinerary before landing at Tours.

**Sighting:** Ahead of the aircraft, at the apparent limit of ground lights, P first saw what he thought might be a green flare. Within 1–2 seconds the light rose about 1,500 m above his altitude, appeared to level off, then descended toward him on what looked like a collision course. It filled the cockpit windshield, and P let go of the controls and crossed his arms in a protective gesture. The aircraft was enveloped in a very bright phosphorescent green light, and he saw a sphere (“S”) that avoided his aircraft at the last moment.

**Assessment:** The report provides a dramatic close visual encounter but no radar track, impact, or independent corroboration on this page. The witness was a trained military pilot, which strengthens the observation, but the object’s nature remains unexplained in the excerpt.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document:** FBI 案卷 255 中的第 p.0014 页是一段法文 UFO 报告摘录。该页先结束了一个单独的 Mirage IV/A1-A2 事件，随后开始了一个新章节，标题为“1.2 Testimony of a Fighter Pilot (March 3, 1976).” 证人在后来归属于 Claude Bosc 的书面陈述中最初要求匿名。该页上未见文件编号、签署人或密级标记。

**Witness:** P 在目击发生时是 Tours 的战斗飞行学校的一名学员飞行员。他当时独自驾驶一架 T-33 训练机执行夜间导航任务，飞行高度为 6,000 m，速度约 460 km/h，按照 Rennes–Nantes–Poitiers 的航线飞行，随后在 Tours 降落。

**Sighting:** 在飞机前方、地面灯光看似的最远边界处，P 最初看到一个他以为可能是绿色照明弹的东西。1–2 秒内，该光点上升到比他当前高度高约 1,500 m，似乎随后趋于平稳，然后又朝他俯冲下来，看起来像是要发生碰撞。它充满了座舱风挡，P 松开操纵杆并交叉双臂作出防护姿势。飞机被一种非常明亮的磷光绿色光芒所包围，他看见一个球体（“S”）在最后一刻避开了他的飞机。

**Assessment:** 这份报告提供了一次戏剧性的近距离视觉遭遇，但在本页上没有雷达航迹、撞击或独立佐证。证人是一名受过训练的军用飞行员，这增强了目击的可信度，但摘录中该物体的性质仍无法解释。

events.location: San Carlos de Bariloche Airport approach, Río Negro, Argentina
events.title: Bariloche airport approach: luminous object shadows AR 674, 31 Jul 1995
events.source: FBI Case File 255 — UFOs and Defense, What Should We Prepare For, p.0021
events.report_summary:
**Document:** This page is a narrative case excerpt labeled “2.5 San Carlos de Bariloche (July 31, 1995)” with the source identified as **SEPRA**. No case number, signatures, or classification markings appear on the page. The event text occupies the upper portion of the page; a new chapter begins immediately below, so only the Bariloche section is included here.

**Witness:** The main witness is the **pilot of Aerolíneas Argentinas flight AR 674** (Boeing 727), with corroboration from the rest of the crew, passengers, the crew of another aircraft on standby, airport controllers, and some local inhabitants.

**Sighting:** On final approach to land at San Carlos de Bariloche, the town lost power and the airport lights went out. The pilot held on standby briefly, then resumed the approach and saw a “strange star.” As the aircraft aligned with the runway, an object resembling a large aircraft appeared off the right side and flew parallel to AR 674. It had **three lights**, including **one red light in the middle**. When airport lighting failed again, the runway and approach lights also extinguished. The same phenomenon was observed from the second aircraft on standby.

**Object:** The object later became luminous, moved behind the airplane, stopped, climbed vertically, stopped again, then moved back in front of the airplane before disappearing toward the **Andes Cordillera**. The account emphasizes unusual maneuverability and sustained visibility over several minutes.

**Assessment:** The report highlights the case as noteworthy because it was independently observed in flight and on the ground, lasted several minutes, involved multiple apparent trajectories, and coincided with an electromagnetic effect (widespread light failure) that the report treats as directly associated with the object. No conventional explanation is offered in the text.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document:** 这一页是一段叙述性案例摘录，标题为“2.5 San Carlos de Bariloche (July 31, 1995)”，来源标注为 **SEPRA**。页面上未见案件编号、签名或机密标记。事件正文占据页面上半部分；其下方立即开始新章节，因此这里只包含 Bariloche 部分。

**Witness:** 主要目击者是 **Aerolíneas Argentinas 航班 AR 674**（波音 727）的飞行员，另有机组其他成员、乘客、另一架待命飞机的机组、机场管制员以及一些当地居民的印证。

**Sighting:** 在最后进近准备降落于 San Carlos de Bariloche 时，镇上突然停电，机场灯光也随之熄灭。飞行员短暂停留待命，随后重新开始进近，并看见一颗“奇怪的星”。当飞机对准跑道时，右侧出现了一个类似大型飞机的物体，并与 AR 674 平行飞行。它有 **三盏灯**，其中 **中间是一盏红灯**。当机场照明再次失灵时，跑道灯和进近灯也一并熄灭。待命中的第二架飞机上也观察到了同样的现象。

**Object:** 该物体随后变得发光，移到飞机后方，停住，垂直爬升，再次停住，然后又移到飞机前方，最终朝 **Andes Cordillera** 方向消失。该叙述强调其异常机动能力，以及在数分钟内持续可见。

**Assessment:** 报告指出，此案之所以值得注意，是因为它在飞行中和地面上都被独立观察到，持续了数分钟，涉及多个表观轨迹，并伴随一种电磁效应（广泛停电），报告将其视为与该物体直接相关。正文未给出任何常规解释。

events.location: Valensole (lavender fields near the village), Alpes-de-Haute-Provence, France
events.title: Maurice Masse, Valensole FR: landed craft and small beings, 1 Jul 1965
events.source: FBI Case File 255 — UFOs and Defense, What Should We Prepare For, p.0024
events.report_summary:
**Document:** This page is a case-history excerpt headed “4.1 Valensole, Alpes-de-Haute-Provence [Department] (July 1, 1965)” and “In-depth investigation by the Gendarmerie Nationale.” No FBI file number, signature block, or classification marking is visible on the page. The bottom of the page begins a new, separate incident (“4.2 Cussac, Cantal”), which is not part of this event.

**Witness:** Maurice Masse left home at about 5:00 a.m. for his lavender fields near Valensole and began work around 6:00 a.m. He is described as the sole eyewitness. The report says he was later questioned by local gendarmes, and that investigators found no indication of mythomania or a staged hoax.

**Sighting:** While lighting a cigarette, Masse heard a hissing sound and saw an object about 90 meters away behind a pile of stones. He approached to roughly 10 meters, thinking it might be thieves. He then observed two small beings; one reportedly pointed a tube at him from a bag on its left side. Masse said he became immobilized, numb, and paralyzed but remained fully aware. After the beings reentered the craft, he watched from behind a dome-like structure as a heavy sound accompanied takeoff.

**Object:** He described the craft as reminiscent of a “Dauphine” automobile on six legs with a central pivot. The tube under the object touched the ground and rotated; the six legs retracted beneath the machine. The object rose vertically, tilted diagonally, and departed faster than a jet.

**Investigation:** Gendarmerie and Digne investigators reportedly found a ground depression with soaked soil, a smooth-walled cylindrical hole about 18 cm across and 40 cm deep, and three bent holes about 6 cm across. Lavender along the flight path was dried out over roughly 100 meters, and replanting failed for years. The report concludes that the physical traces and witness reaction made the account plausible despite some contradictions.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document:** 本页是一段案件历史摘录，标题为“4.1 Valensole, Alpes-de-Haute-Provence [Department] (July 1, 1965)”以及“In-depth investigation by the Gendarmerie Nationale.” 页面上未见 FBI 档案编号、签名栏或分类标记。页底开始了一个新的、独立的事件（“4.2 Cussac, Cantal”），不属于本事件。

**Witness:** Maurice Masse 于约 5:00 a.m. 离开家，前往 Valensole 附近的薰衣草田，并在约 6:00 a.m. 开始工作。文中称他是唯一目击者。报告说，他后来接受了当地宪兵的询问，调查人员未发现任何夸大妄想或伪造骗局的迹象。

**Sighting:** Masse 在点烟时听到嘶嘶声，并看到约 90 meters 外、石堆后方有一个物体。他走近到约 10 meters，起初以为是盗贼。随后他看见两个小生物；据称其中一个从其左侧袋中取出一支管状物对准了他。Masse 表示自己随后动弹不得、麻木并瘫痪，但意识完全清醒。那些生物重新进入飞行器后，他从一个穹顶状结构后方观察，只听到沉重的声响伴随着起飞。

**Object:** 他将该飞行器描述为类似一辆带六条腿、中央有一个枢轴的“Dauphine”汽车。物体下方的管状部分触地并旋转；六条腿收拢到机器下方。该物体垂直升空，斜向倾斜后离去，速度比喷气式飞机还快。

**Investigation:** 据称，宪兵和 Digne 的调查人员发现地面有一处凹陷，土壤浸湿；还有一个壁面平滑的圆柱形孔洞，直径约 18 cm、深约 40 cm，以及三个弯曲的孔洞，直径约 6 cm。沿飞行路径约 100 meters 范围内的薰衣草都已干枯，且多年补种均未成功。报告最后认为，尽管存在一些矛盾之处，但这些物理痕迹和目击者的反应使该叙述具有可信性。

events.date_raw: Night of July 28 to 29, 1989; KGB-declassified file (1991), publicized in AURA-Z, March 1993
events.location: Kapustin Yar missile base (near Astrakhan, Astrakhan Oblast, Russia)
events.title: Kapustin Yar missile base: multiple UFOs over Soviet guards, 28-29 Jul 1989
events.source: FBI Case File 255 — UFOs and Defense, What Should We Prepare For, p.0023
events.report_summary:
**Document:** This page introduces section 3.3, a case from a KGB-declassified UFO file concerning an army missile base near Kapustin Yar in the Astrakhan region. The English-language account says the file reached the public through the March 1993 issue of *AURA-Z*. The file is described as incomplete and does not mention any radar detections. It compiles seven written testimonies from military personnel at two centers on the base.

**Witnesses:** The first center contributed five statements: Lieutenant Klimenko, two corporals, and two soldiers, who all reported seeing the objects under good visibility. A second nearby center contributed two more testimonies, including a detailed deposition by Second Lieutenant Volochine, who attached a sketch. Soldier Tichaev later filed a report consistent with his superior’s account.

**Sighting:** The main sightings occurred on the night of July 28–29, 1989, with observations spanning roughly 2215 to 0130 hours. Witnesses placed the objects from a few kilometers away down to about 300 m. Up to three UFOs were seen at once. One was said to move jerkily, with abrupt starts and stops and periods of immobility; a fighter jet attempted to approach one object, which then escaped at extreme speed, leaving the impression the aircraft had been hovering.

**Object:** Volochine described a disk about 4–5 m across with a brightly lit hemispherical dome. It sometimes moved abruptly but silently and sometimes hovered 20–60 m above the ground. Tichaev reported a phosphorescent green light and a moving beam that illuminated a missile depot for several seconds. Witnesses emphasized the lack of noise, ruling out a helicopter. The page concludes that the incident remained unexplained.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document:** 本页介绍第3.3节，内容为一份经克格勃解密的UFO档案案例，涉及阿斯特拉罕州（Astrakhan region）卡普斯京亚尔（Kapustin Yar）附近一处陆军导弹基地。英文资料称，该档案于1993年3月刊的 *AURA-Z* 上首次向公众披露。档案被描述为并不完整，且未提及任何雷达探测记录。其汇编了来自基地内两个中心的军人所作的7份书面证词。

**Witnesses:** 第一个中心提供了5份陈述：克林坚科（Klimenko）中尉、两名下士和两名士兵，他们都表示在能见度良好的情况下看到了这些物体。附近第二个中心又提供了另外两份证词，其中包括沃洛申（Volochine）少尉的一份详细陈述，他还附上了一幅草图。士兵蒂恰耶夫（Tichaev）后来提交了一份报告，其内容与其上级的说法一致。

**Sighting:** 主要目击发生在1989年7月28日至29日夜间，观测时间大约从2215时持续到0130时。证人估计这些物体距离他们从几千米到约300 m不等。最多曾同时看到3个UFO。据称其中一个移动时显得很突兀，时而急起急停，时而静止不动；一架战斗机曾试图接近其中一个物体，但该物体随即以极高速度逃离，给人的印象是那架飞机当时一直在悬停。

**Object:** 沃洛申（Volochine）描述了一个直径约4–5 m的碟状物体，顶部有一个明亮发光的半球形穹顶。它有时会突然移动，但没有任何声音；有时则悬停在离地20–60 m的高度。蒂恰耶夫（Tichaev）报告看到一种磷光绿色光芒，以及一束移动的光束，曾照亮一个导弹仓库数秒。证人们都强调没有任何噪音，因此排除了直升机的可能。页面最后指出，这一事件至今仍未得到解释。

events.date_raw: Around 11:00 p.m. on September 18, 1976; section heading: "Tehran (September 18 to 19, 1976)"
events.title: Tehran UFO: luminous object, radar/F-4 interference, 18-19 Sep 1976
events.source: FBI Case File 255 — UFOs and Defense, What Should We Prepare For, p.0019
events.report_summary:
**Document:** Section 2.3 of a larger case narrative titled “Tehran (September 18 to 19, 1976).” The page says the incident was reported in newspapers worldwide, that an American citizen later obtained a report from the Defense Intelligence Agency under the Freedom of Information Act, and that additional U.S. documents and interviews with Iranian officials and air-traffic personnel later helped confirm and supplement it. No signer, file code, or classification stamp is visible on this rendered page.

**Witness:** The first-hand observer named here is Hossain Perouzi, the Tehran airport night-shift controller. Additional observations are attributed to General Youssefi of the Imperial Iranian Air Force and to two F-4 crews.

**Sighting:** Around 11:00 p.m. on 18 Sep 1976, the Tehran airport control tower received multiple calls about a stationary luminous object over the Shemiran residential district in northern Tehran. Perouzi viewed it with binoculars and described a rectangle, probably a cylindrical object, with bluish-white pulsing lights at both ends and a small red light in the center tracing a circle. Youssefi also saw an object like a star but much larger and brighter, and he ordered an F-4 intercept.

**Object/Effects:** When the first F-4 closed to about 45 km, its flight instruments and communications reportedly stopped working; the pilot aborted the interception and returned to base, after which the crew regained use of the systems. A second F-4 tracked a radar echo similar to a Boeing 707. As it approached at roughly 280 km/h relative speed, the target accelerated and maintained a constant 45 km separation. The page presents the case as a multi-witness visual-and-radar incident with alleged electromagnetic interference, but it offers no final explanation.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document:** 更大规模案件叙述中“Tehran (September 18 to 19, 1976)”的第2.3节。该页写道，此事件曾被世界各地报纸报道，一名美国公民后来根据《信息自由法》(Freedom of Information Act) 从 Defense Intelligence Agency 获得了一份报告，而随后获得的其他美国文件以及对伊朗官员和空中交通人员的访谈，进一步帮助证实并补充了这一事件。此页的渲染版本上未见签署人、文件代码或密级戳记。

**Witness:** 此处所指的第一手目击者是 Hossain Perouzi，Tehran 机场夜班管制员。另有观察记录归于 Imperial Iranian Air Force 的 General Youssefi 以及两组 F-4 机组人员。

**Sighting:** 1976年9月18日晚上约11:00，Tehran 机场塔台接到多通电话，称在 Tehran 北部 Shemiran 居民区上空有一个静止发光物体。Perouzi 用双筒望远镜观察后，将其描述为一个矩形，可能是圆柱形物体，两端有蓝白色脉冲灯，中间有一盏小红灯，沿圆周移动。Youssefi 也看见了一个像星星但大得多、亮得多的物体，并下令派出一架 F-4 进行拦截。

**Object/Effects:** 当第一架 F-4 接近到约45 km时，其飞行仪表和通信据称全部失灵；飞行员中止拦截并返回基地，随后机组恢复了系统使用。第二架 F-4 追踪到一个类似 Boeing 707 的雷达回波。 当它以约280 km/h的相对速度接近时，目标加速并始终保持45 km的恒定间距。该页将此案描述为一宗涉及多名目击者、视觉与雷达同时观测、并据称伴有电磁干扰的事件，但未给出最终解释。

events.date_raw: 29 August 1967; second GEPAN inquiry began in 1978
events.title: Cussac, France: bright sphere and small black beings, 29 Aug 1967
events.source: FBI Case File 255 — UFOs and Defense, What Should We Prepare For, p.0025
events.report_summary:
**Document:** This page continues a French UFO case summary and cites the **second inquiry begun in 1978** by **GEPAN** with outside advisers, including a former examining magistrate. The page then immediately starts a separate heading for **Trans-en-Provence (8 Jan 1981)**, which is a different incident and is not included here.

**Witness:** The principal witnesses were a **13-year-old boy** and his sister. The narrative says the boy first noticed four unknown figures on the other side of the road and called to his sister. A gendarme and another nearby witness later provided supporting testimony.

**Sighting:** The children observed an **extremely bright sphere** near the road. Four small black beings, described as no more than **1.20 m** tall, were seen beside it; one knelt before the sphere and another held a mirror-like object that blinded the children. The beings retreated, rose from the ground, and entered the sphere headfirst. The craft then lifted off with a **hissing sound**, climbed in a **spiral**, and disappeared at high speed. A **strong sulfur odor** filled the air, and the dog barked while cows mooed.

**Investigation:** The later inquiry added **secondary witnesses** who strengthened the case: a gendarme arriving immediately after the event found tracks on the ground at the place indicated by the children and noted the sulfur smell, while another witness from a nearby granary recalled a distinct hissing noise unlike a helicopter. A site reconstruction confirmed the descriptive account and the follow-on circumstances. The children reportedly suffered from **physiological disorders** and **eye problems for several days**; these effects were certified by the family doctor and confirmed by their father, who was then **mayor of the village**. The judge concluded there was **“no flaw or inconsistency”** suggesting hoax, invention, or hallucination, and stated that the witnesses appeared to have genuinely observed the घटना.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document:** 这一页继续介绍一个法国UFO案件摘要，并提到由 **GEPAN** 在 **1978年** 发起的**第二次调查**，该调查还邀请了外部顾问，包括一名前预审法官。随后页面立即开始了一个单独的标题 **Trans-en-Provence (8 Jan 1981)**，这是另一起不同的事件，此处不予收入。

**Witness:** 主要目击者是一名 **13岁男孩** 及其妹妹。叙述称，男孩最先注意到公路另一侧有四个不明人物，并呼喊妹妹前来看。后来，一名宪兵和另一名附近目击者提供了支持性证词。

**Sighting:** 孩子们看见公路附近有一个**极其明亮的球体**。球体旁边有四个黑色小生物，被描述为身高不超过 **1.20 m**；其中一个跪在球体前，另一个拿着一个类似镜子的物体，致使孩子们目眩。随后，这些生物后退、从地面上升起，并头朝前进入球体。接着，飞行器伴随着**嘶嘶声**起飞，以**螺旋**方式爬升，并高速消失。空气中弥漫着**强烈的硫磺气味**，狗在吠叫，牛也在哞叫。

**Investigation:** 后续调查又补充了**次要目击者**，从而加强了该案：一名在事发后立即赶到的宪兵在孩子们所指地点的地面上发现了痕迹，并注意到硫磺气味；而来自附近谷仓的另一名目击者则回忆起一种与直升机不同、十分明显的嘶嘶声。现场重建证实了上述描述以及随后发生的情况。据称，孩子们还出现了**生理紊乱**以及**持续数日的眼部问题**；这些情况已由家庭医生证明，并得到其父亲的确认，而其父亲当时是该村的**市长**。法官最终得出结论，认为没有任何**“缺陷或不一致之处”**表明这是恶作剧、编造或幻觉，并表示目击者似乎确实观察到了这一事件。

events.report_summary:
**Document:** This page is a scan from a longer UFO dossier excerpt. The upper portion finishes an unrelated Antananarivo, Madagascar report, then a new section begins: “3.2 Sighting by a Pilot of a Saucer Close to the Ground (December 9, 1979).” The page itself does not show an FBI case number, classification marking, or signature block; the incident write-up is presented as a **GEPAN/SEPRA investigation and testimony before the committee**.

**Witness:** The principal witness was **Jean-Pierre Fartek (F)**, a former Air Force Lieutenant-Colonel who had flown Mirage III fighters in the 2nd fighter squadron at Dijon and was, at the time of the report, a pilot for a private company. His wife was the second witness. They lived in the same village near Dijon, with their house at the end of a housing development overlooking fields.

**Sighting:** On **1979-12-09 at about 9:15 a.m.**, Fartek and his wife saw an unusual object in a field near their house. Weather and visibility were described as excellent. The object hovered roughly **3 m above the ground** in front of a grove of trees about **250 m** away, which partly concealed it.

**Object:** The witnesses estimated the object at **about 20 m in diameter and 7 m thick**. Fartek described it as resembling **two superposed saucers** with very distinct contours, inverted one on top of the other, and with **no portholes or lights**. It was **metallic gray on the upper portion** and **darker/bluish on the lower portion**, separated by a sharp boundary that the witness said could not be explained by lighting. The craft was said to be in **constant slight oscillation**, as if trying to balance.

**Investigation:** The page presents the account as a formal case study from the French UFO research apparatus (GEPAN/SEPRA). No identification or conventional explanation is offered in the excerpt. The page also suggests the witness was considered credible due to his aviation background and the agreement between husband and wife on the object’s appearance and behavior.
events.report_summary_zh:

events.date_raw: around 12:35 a.m. after work on October 21, 1982; document dated October 21, 1982
events.title: Nancy, France: oval metallic craft hovers 20 minutes, 21 Oct 1982
events.source: FBI Case File 255 — UFOs and Defense, What Should We Prepare For, p.0026
events.report_summary:
**Document:** This page is a continuation of a French UFO case compendium: the top half closes an unrelated Trans-en-Provence report, then a new subsection begins, "4.4 Nancy, Meurthe-et-Moselle [Department], the so-called 'Amaranth' Case (October 21, 1982)." The page identifies it as a **GEPAN/SEPRA investigation** and says the gendarmerie recorded the testimony less than five hours after the sighting.

**Witness:** The primary witness was a **cellular biology researcher** who was in his garden in front of his house after work. The testimony emphasizes clear conditions: no clouds, the sun not in his eyes, and excellent visibility.

**Sighting:** The witness first thought the object was an airplane approaching from the southeast, but it descended toward him, causing him to back away 3 to 4 meters. It then stopped about one meter above the ground and hovered for about 20 minutes. He said he checked his watch, making him confident about the duration.

**Object:** He described an ovoid craft about 1 m in diameter and 80 cm thick. The lower half looked metallic, like polished beryllium, while the upper half was blue-green, like the inner depths of a lagoon. He reported no noise and no apparent emission of heat, cold, radiation, magnetism, or electromagnetism. After 20 minutes it rose straight up very quickly, as if under strong suction, and vanished.

**Investigation:** The page notes that there were no tracks or marks on the ground and that the grass was not charred or flattened. Because the excerpt ends mid-report, no final conclusion appears here; the case is presented as an unexplained close-range hovering object with no obvious conventional explanation.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document:** 本页是法国 UFO 案例汇编的续页：上半部分结束了一则无关的 Trans-en-Provence 报告，随后开始一个新的小节，题为“4.4 Nancy, Meurthe-et-Moselle [Department], 所谓的 ‘Amaranth’ 案例（1982年10月21日）。” 页面将其标识为一次 **GEPAN/SEPRA investigation**，并说明宪兵队在目击后不足五小时就记录了证词。

**Witness:** 主要目击者是一名 **cellular biology researcher**，当时下班后正在自家房前的花园里。证词强调当时条件非常清楚：天空无云，太阳没有照到他的眼睛，能见度极佳。

**Sighting:** 目击者起初以为该物体是一架从东南方向接近的飞机，但它随后下降朝他飞来，迫使他向后退了3到4米。接着它停在离地面约一米处，并悬停了大约20分钟。他说自己看过手表，因此对持续时间很有把握。

**Object:** 他描述该飞行物呈卵形，直径约1 m，厚度约80 cm。下半部分看起来是金属质地，像抛光的铍；上半部分则呈蓝绿色，像泻湖深处的内部色泽。他称没有听到任何声音，也没有发现热、冷、辐射、磁性或电磁性的明显释放。20分钟后，它像是受到强烈吸引一样迅速直线升起，随后消失。

**Investigation:** 页面指出，地面上没有任何轨迹或痕迹，草也没有被烧焦或压平。由于摘录在报告中途结束，这里没有给出最终结论；该案例被呈现为一个无法解释的近距离悬停物体，且没有明显的常规解释。

events.report_summary:
**Document:** This page is a single AFP news clipping reproduced in the file, titled “UFO Shuts Down Russian Airport.” No FBI case stamp, signer, or investigative memorandum is visible on the page itself. The story is datelined Moscow, Jan. 27, 2001, and cites Interfax plus local aviation company director Ivan Komarov as the quoted source.

**Witness:** The primary eyewitnesses were the crew of an Il-76 cargo aircraft at Barnaul Airport in southern Siberia. According to the article, they refused to take off after reporting a luminous object hovering above the runway. A second cargo aircraft crew similarly declined to use the runway and landed at another airport.

**Sighting:** The reported event occurred on Friday, Jan. 26, 2001, at Barnaul Airport, Barnaul, Altai Krai, Russia. Airport operations were halted for about an hour and a half. The object is described only as a “UFO” or “luminescent object” hovering above the runway; no size, shape, maneuvering detail, or sound is given.

**Investigation / assessment:** The article provides no formal technical investigation, radar data, or physical evidence. The only corroboration mentioned is the operational impact on multiple aircraft crews and the temporary shutdown. The object reportedly “took off and vanished” after 90 minutes, but the piece offers no explanation or identification beyond the witnesses’ reports.
events.report_summary_zh:

**Witness:** 主要目击者是位于俄罗斯西伯利亚南部 Barnaul Airport 的一架 Il-76 货机机组人员。根据报道，他们在称一发光物体悬停于跑道上空后拒绝起飞。另一架货机的机组也同样拒绝使用该跑道，并改降至另一座机场。

**Sighting:** 所报告事件发生于 2001 年 1 月 26 日星期五，地点为 Russia, Barnaul Airport, Barnaul, Altai Krai。机场运行因此中断约一个半小时。文中对该物体的描述仅为悬停在跑道上方的“UFO”或“luminescent object”；未提供其大小、形状、机动细节或声音信息。

**Investigation / assessment:** 该报道未提供正式的技术调查、雷达数据或实物证据。文中提到的唯一佐证，是该事件对多架飞机机组造成的运营影响，以及机场的短暂停运。据称该物体在 90 分钟后“起飞并消失”，但除目击者陈述外，文章未给出任何解释或身份认定。

events.date_raw: Night of March 10 to 11, 1979; GEPAN/SEPRA investigation noted March 13, 1979
events.title: Dombes village glow, 10 Mar 1979
events.source: FBI Case File 255 — UFOs and Defense, What Should We Prepare For, p.0028
events.report_summary:
**Document:** The page is a secondary-source case writeup headed “A Bright Glow in a Village in the Dombes Region (March 10, 1979)” and “GEPAN/SEPRA investigation.” No FBI file number, classification stamp, or signers are visible in the excerpt; the page instead summarizes a French official investigation later reproduced in a book chapter.

**Witness:** Four testimonies were recorded, three of them described as totally independent. The first was a village restaurateur; two others were motorists near the village; the fourth was a fish farmer. Their accounts were broadly consistent and included visual, auditory, and environmental effects.

**Sighting:** On the night of March 10–11, 1979, the first witness described a bluish, purplish luminous mass, slightly oval and about 15 meters long. He said the village square was lit as bright as daylight and the automatic public lighting shut off. Two motorists said the luminous mass moved about 2 meters in front of their car, and that the light went out suddenly after orange-colored lights appeared on both sides of the glow. The fish farmer said he woke to a dull noise, saw a bright bluish glow, and later found fish dead in one tank.

**Investigation:** GEPAN/SEPRA inspected the site a few days later and found the 10-kV line over the tank had melted. EDF information suggested the line, about 30 years old, had suffered corrosion/oxidation of aluminum conductors, likely producing a power arc and corona discharge. That electrical event was judged sufficient to explain the bluish glow, the noise, and the failure of the village lighting; the glow was also bright enough to trigger a nearby photoelectric cell. The fish deaths were attributed to aluminum droplets falling into the tank, supporting an electrical-origin explanation rather than a true UFO event.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document:** 该页是一份二手资料的个案摘要，标题为“Dombes地区一个村庄中的明亮光辉（1979年3月10日）”以及“GEPAN/SEPRA调查”。摘录中未见 FBI 档案编号、分类印章或签署人；该页实际上是在概述一项法国官方调查，后被收入书籍章节中再版。

**Witness:** 共记录了四份证词，其中三份被描述为完全独立。第一位证人是一名村里的餐馆老板；另外两位是经过村庄附近的驾车者；第四位是一名养鱼场主。各自的陈述总体一致，并包括视觉、听觉以及环境方面的影响。

**Sighting:** 1979年3月10日至11日夜间，第一位证人描述看到一个带蓝紫色的发光物体，略呈椭圆形，长约15米。他说，村庄广场亮得如同白昼，自动公共照明随即关闭。两位驾车者称，这个发光物体在他们的汽车前方约2米处移动，并且在光晕两侧出现橙色灯光后，亮光突然熄灭。养鱼场主说，他被一阵低沉的噪音惊醒，看到一道明亮的蓝色光辉，后来发现一个水槽里的鱼都死了。

**Investigation:** GEPAN/SEPRA在几天后对现场进行了勘查，发现位于水槽上方的10-kV线路已经熔化。EDF提供的信息表明，这条大约已有30年历史的线路出现了铝导体腐蚀/氧化，可能产生了电弧和电晕放电。调查认为，这一电气事件足以解释蓝色光辉、噪音以及村庄照明失灵的现象；此外，该光辉的亮度也足以触发附近的光电池。鱼类死亡则被归因于铝滴落入水槽中，因此支持了电气起因的解释，而非真实的 UFO 事件。

events.title: Paris–Lille freeway red sphere mistaken for UFO, 29 Sep 1988
events.source: FBI Case File 255 — UFOs and Defense, What Should We Prepare For, p.0027
events.report_summary:
**Document:** Page p.0027 is a book excerpt from Chapter 5, “Counterexamples of Phenomena That Have Been Explained,” section 5.1, “A Strange Object Crosses a Highway (September 29, 1988).” The page explicitly cites a **GEPAN/SEPRA investigation** and describes a French case later resolved as a conventional explanation rather than an anomalous aerial event.

**Witness:** The principal witness was an **auto mechanic driving on the Paris–Lille freeway**. He was accompanied by his family, who were also treated as part of the follow-up response after the sighting. The account presents him as a lay witness with no special observational equipment, but his report was taken seriously enough to trigger a major police and technical response.

**Sighting:** On 1988-09-29, the driver saw an **enormous red ball** cross the road a few dozen meters in front of him and roll down below the roadway, emitting reflections and appearing enveloped in dense smoke. The event caused alarm; highway gendarmes sealed off the freeway and a multi-kilometer zone around the object. Civilian and military security personnel arrived with **Geiger counters**, and the witness and family underwent hospital examinations. At the time, officials briefly considered a possible link to the Soviet satellite **Cosmos 1900**.

**Object / Conclusion:** When CNES was consulted, it was quickly confirmed that Cosmos 1900 was not involved. The object was later identified as a **decorative sphere for a Jean-Michel Jarre concert** that had fallen from the truck transporting it to London. The sphere’s mirrored surface and intact appearance explained the light reflections; no smoke or radioactivity was found near it. The page’s analytical point is that a dramatic “UFO” report can arise from an ordinary transported object, even after an extensive official response.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document:** 第 p.0027 页摘自第 5 章“已被解释的现象的反例”中的一段内容，具体为 5.1 节“一个奇怪的物体穿过高速公路（1988年9月29日）”。该页明确引用了一次 **GEPAN/SEPRA investigation**，并描述了一个法国案例，后来被证实属于常规解释，而非异常空中事件。

**Witness:** 主要目击者是一名**在 Paris–Lille 高速公路上驾驶的汽车修理工**。当时他还与家人同行，在目击事件之后，家人也被纳入后续响应的一部分。文中将他描述为一名没有特殊观测设备的普通目击者，但他的报告仍被认真对待，以至于引发了大规模的警方和技术响应。

**Sighting:** 在 1988-09-29，驾驶员看到一个**巨大的红色球体**在距离他前方几十米处横穿道路，并滚落到路面下方，发出反光，且看起来被浓烟包围。该事件引起了恐慌；高速公路宪兵封锁了该高速公路以及周围数公里范围内的区域。民用和军事安保人员携带**Geiger counters**赶到现场，目击者及其家人也接受了医院检查。当时，官方曾短暂考虑过与苏联卫星 **Cosmos 1900** 的可能关联。

**Object / Conclusion:** 在向 CNES 咨询后，很快确认 Cosmos 1900 与此事无关。后来查明，该物体实际上是一个**Jean-Michel Jarre 音乐会用的装饰球体**，它从运送其前往 London 的卡车上掉落下来。球体的镜面外表和完好外观解释了光线反射现象；其附近未发现烟雾或放射性。该页的分析要点是：即使在官方进行了广泛响应之后，一个戏剧性的“UFO”报告也可能源自一个普通的运输物体。

events.title: Jefferson, OR area: possible flying-disc photos, 5-12 Nov 1946
events.source: FBI Case File 62-HQ-83894 Box 18 General 1946-7 Vol 2, p.0006
events.record_description: This file contains memorandums and correspondence related to flying disc/saucer sightings and that those are a matter of concern for the Air Materiel Command.
events.report_summary:
**Document:** Confidential Fourth Air Force memo, file no. 4AFDA-3/1208-I, dated 5 Dec 1947, from Headquarters Fourth Air Force, Office of the Assistant Chief of Staff, A-2 Intelligence, Hamilton Field, California. Signed by Lt. Col. Donald L. Springer, AC of S, A-2, and addressed to the Chief of Staff, United States Air Force, ATTN: Director of Intelligence. The memo states that three photographs were enclosed.

**Witness:** The photographs were attributed to Mary L. Herren of 1728 S.W. Bidwell Avenue, Portland 2, Oregon, identified as the source from whom the material was obtained. The memo describes her as a very reliable source of information, but she was not presented as a direct eyewitness to the aerial objects.

**Sighting:** The images were said to have been taken sometime between 5 and 12 Nov 1946 in the vicinity of Jefferson, Oregon. Herren reportedly said the formation shown in the photographs consisted of objects she did not recall seeing herself, but which she thought might possibly be flying discs.

**Object:** The memo refers only to objects visible in the sky area of each photograph, with no detailed size, shape, altitude, speed, or maneuvering information. The Air Force analyst noted that the uniform markings in the photos suggested the camera or film may have been defective.

**Investigation:** The Fourth Air Force reported that no flying-disc incidents had been reported from that vicinity on or about the dates cited. The document’s tone and conclusion are skeptical: the evidence was treated as photograph-based, possibly compromised by a photographic defect, rather than as corroborated visual observation of a real aerial craft.**
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document:** 机密第四空军备忘录，档案号 4AFDA-3/1208-I，日期为 1947年12月5日，来自第四空军总部、助理参谋长办公室、A-2 情报处，地点为加利福尼亚州 Hamilton Field。由中校 Donald L. Springer，AC of S，A-2 签署，致美国空军参谋长，ATTN: 情报主任。备忘录说明随附三张照片。

**Witness:** 这些照片被归因于位于 Oregon州 Portland 2，1728 S.W. Bidwell Avenue 的 Mary L. Herren，她被认定为获取这些材料的来源。备忘录将她描述为一个非常可靠的信息来源，但并未将她表述为这些空中物体的直接目击者。

**Sighting:** 据称，这些图像拍摄于 1946年11月5日至12日之间，地点在 Oregon州 Jefferson 附近。Herren 据报说，照片中所示的编队由一些她不记得亲眼见过的物体组成，但她认为这些物体也许可能是飞碟。

events.report_summary:
**Document:** Confidential Eleventh Air Force memorandum from Headquarters, 11th Air Force, Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, addressed to the Chief of Staff, United States Air Force (ATTN: Director of Intelligence, Requirements Division). It cites ADC Letter 45-5 (25 March 1948) and states that the attached FBI report was received at headquarters on 27 May 1948 from Special Agent D. K. Brown of the FBI office in Cleveland, Ohio. The memo also notes that copies were forwarded to HQ Air Materiel Command and HQ Air Defense Command. The headquarters says it has no further information and is not initiating its own investigation.

**Witness:** The report names several local witnesses connected with the New York Central System: Ben Rupe, a car inspector; Earl Roush, also a car inspector; Bob White, a yard clerk; and C. K. Hite, a patrolman. Their addresses are not given. Weather at the time is listed as unknown.

**Sighting:** The incident is placed at Hobson, Ohio, on the night of 8 May 1948. The object is described only as round; the number of objects was not known. Size was estimated at about nine inches in diameter as viewed from ground level. No photograph or sketch is known to this headquarters, and the page provides no details on color, altitude, speed, sound, or duration.

**Assessment:** This page is best read as a brief intelligence forwarding report rather than a full field investigation. The witnesses appear to have been railroad personnel and a railroad patrolman, which gives the account some local credibility, but the phenomenology is sparse and the object description is too limited to support a firm identification.
